title: 鹰派也撑不住：日元或跌至165，日本央行被逼到墙角
speaker: Masahiko Hikulu

segments.en: What do you think your way that's going to say in terms of signaling further hikes to come? I think you pretty much stay neutral to slightly hawkish, right?
segments.zh: 您认为日本央行会如何释放进一步加息的信号？我认为基本上会保持中性偏鹰的立场。

segments.en: There's no way for him to go back to be behind a curve or dovish as we have seen what happened to Yen, right? If he is overly dovish, Yen will sell off to 161, 165.
segments.zh: 他不可能再回到落后于曲线或偏鸽的立场，因为我们已经看到日元的表现。如果他过于鸽派，日元会走弱至161、165。

segments.en: If he is at neutral saying that you'll be there dependent and then going forward every B.O.J. meeting is a live meeting that will keep the expectation alive and Yen will trade around current levels, right, 150 to 155.
segments.zh: 如果他保持中性，表示将依赖数据，并且未来每次日本央行会议都是实时会议，这将使预期保持活跃，日元将在当前水平附近交易，大约150至155。

segments.en: Anything specific around changes to the statement or tone or in the press brief? Anything that you think we should be paying attention to? I think it's more like, you know, damn signaling that going forward every meeting of B.O.J. will be life for it.
segments.zh: 声明或基调或新闻发布会有什么具体变化吗？您认为我们应该关注什么？我认为更重要的是，要明确释放信号，未来每次日本央行会议都将充满变数。

segments.en: I think that that is the key to catch, right? If you didn't signal that, which I think is very likely he will do that, right? If B.O.J. doesn't do that, that will leave market with a leeway to actually short the Yen again. Right.
segments.zh: 我认为这是关键所在。如果他没有释放这个信号——我认为他很可能这样做——如果日本央行不这样做，市场将再次有空间做空日元。
